# OpenLife Routine v1.0.0 — MVP Public Release

> Build better days, one routine at a time.

## 🎉 First public release!

OpenLife Routine is an open-source, privacy-first, offline-first daily routine reminder app built with Flutter.

## ✨ What's included

- **Onboarding** — 5-screen flow
- **Routine CRUD** — 8 categories, notes, snooze
- **Today Checklist** — progress ring, done/skip/undo, greeting
- **Reminders** — local notifications with snooze
- **Insights** — weekly chart, streak, metrics
- **Templates** — 5 seed packs, one-tap apply
- **Settings** — theme, language (EN/ID), export/import, reset
- **Animations** — Rive wrapper with 10 PNG illustrations
- **188 tests** — unit, widget, BLoC

## 📦 Download

Download the APK below and install on any Android device.

## 🔧 Tech Stack

Flutter 3.x · BLoC · Drift SQLite · go_router · flutter_local_notifications · Rive
